main_text.l: XLVIII. Practicus est, cujus intellectio & ratio-
cinatio propter opus, ac Bonum efficiendum fusci-
pitur.
XLVIII. Circa Objectum versatur tale; quod
aliter se habere poteft, & à voluntate humana depen-
det. Notitiam practicam, quæ poft cognitionem
ulteriorem, ad quam ordinata eft, operationem exi-
git, producit.
XLIX. Conducit autem operatio illa practica
vel ad mores hominum, unde Moralis dicitur, in-
nixa principio Legis naturæ, & recto rationis dicta-
mini, unde Assensus ortum accipit: vel è mente factiva
emanat, quæ dependentia nomen eiactionis Ar-
tificialis indit.
L. Et hæc tandem omnia intellectui infunt, vel li-
berè se habenti, remque aut certò scienti, aut dubi-
tandi opinantive, ac ob infirmitatem accidentem
labascenti: Vel strictè, dum intellectioni,
alienæ propriæve, præteritæ tamen
intentus, cogitata resolvit ac
recognoscit.
DEO TRINO, ET UNI, LAUS,
HONOR ET GLORIA.

page.notes: Printed text is set in long s form; the stroke-like marks on the left edge are show-through/fold and not transcribed. Italic references in the first paragraph are printed in the text line. Some words in the scan are faint or blurred (e.g. "Jope", "Assensus", "factiva") and may need checking. The "XLVIII." heading in the second paragraph is a numbered thesis and is not a true heading; it is marked as a head here only because of its position, and the third paragraph's numeral reads XLVIII as printed in the scan, probably XLIX-type error left as printed.
